lenses.decisionQuestion: Where is the system boundary, who/what is outside it, and which interfaces/lifecycle relations determine whole-system outcomes?
prerequisites: a system of interest can be named
contraindications: the domain-native boundary is already explicit and no whole-system ambiguity remains

lenses.decisionQuestion: Does the observed interaction structure support or contradict the current decomposition/module boundaries?
prerequisites: enough interaction evidence exists to build a meaningful dependency matrix/graph
contraindications: very sparse graph with no disputed boundary
similarity without dependency evidence

lenses.decisionQuestion: Which state, observations, controllers, delays, disturbances and feedback loops govern dynamic behavior?
prerequisites: behavior evolves over time and feedback can affect later state
contraindications: purely static structure with no meaningful feedback question

lenses.decisionQuestion: Can unacceptable loss arise from unsafe control or interaction even when components locally behave as designed?
prerequisites: an unacceptable loss or consequential system state can be defined
contraindications: generic low-consequence bug review with no system-level loss/control question

lenses.decisionQuestion: Can this component be composed or replaced without strengthening hidden assumptions or weakening required guarantees?
prerequisites: candidate components and required environment/guarantees can be stated
contraindications: no composition/replacement decision exists

lenses.sourceSubstrate: structural causal models / intervention and identifiability reasoning
lenses.decisionQuestion: Would intervening on X change Y under the stated causal assumptions, or is the effect not identified?
prerequisites: a causal estimand/intervention can be stated
contraindications: pure description with no causal or intervention claim

lenses.decisionQuestion: How do explicit failure modes propagate, or which credible cause paths produce a specified top failure?
prerequisites: functions/failure modes or a top undesired event can be bounded
contraindications: loss arises primarily from unsafe interaction with no component/process failure; prefer STPA

lenses.decisionQuestion: Can protected information influence an observation or sink that the intended observer should not see?
prerequisites: protected source and observer/sink can be stated
contraindications: the question is effect authority without information visibility; use authority/security/control methods instead

lenses.decisionQuestion: How should repeated trial budget be allocated among already-defined comparable options as feedback arrives?
contraindications: one-shot choice
heterogeneous open concept search
unstable or meaningless reward

lenses.decisionQuestion: How should concept space and knowledge space co-expand when the desired object/design is not yet known?
prerequisites: there is a genuine generative design question rather than only known-alternative optimization
contraindications: routine implementation
known comparable options where only allocation/selection remains

lenses.decisionQuestion: Can a bounded population be varied and selected using a trustworthy evaluator without Goodhart collapse?
prerequisites: evaluator is trustworthy for the bounded objective
contraindications: whole-product value is unobserved and fitness is only a convenient proxy
no stable candidate representation

lenses.decisionQuestion: How do semi-autonomous units coordinate, adapt, preserve identity and match environmental variety without false centralization?
prerequisites: an organizational system and environment can be bounded
contraindications: candidate-search problem with no organization/control-structure question
using VSM as a five-service template

lenses.sourceSubstrate: systems dynamics / deep-uncertainty decision / robustness synthesis
lenses.decisionQuestion: Has the governing regime changed upstream even though downstream levels lag, and what robust action survives uncertainty?
prerequisites: a candidate regime boundary and delayed/stock-flow mechanism can be stated
contraindications: ordinary stationary variation with no structural-change hypothesis

lenses.sourceSubstrate: security engineering composition over information flow, control/STPA, authority/effect/persistence analysis
lenses.decisionQuestion: Are identity, read/derive/network/persist/effect authority, controls, commit points and reconciliation aligned across an agentic capability?
prerequisites: an agentic capability or authority/data/effect pipeline can be bounded
contraindications: generic vulnerability checklist with no meaningful authority/data/effect boundary
